jurisdictionNote: High Court for the National Capital Territory of Delhi. Has original, appellate, and writ jurisdiction. Handles anticipatory bail under S.482 BNSS, criminal appeals, writ petitions under Article 226/227, company matters, and IPR disputes.

localRules: All petitions must be filed through an advocate enrolled with the Bar Council of Delhi or an AOR.
Anticipatory bail applications must be accompanied by a duly sworn affidavit.
Certified copy of FIR, remand order, and charge sheet (if filed) must be annexed.
Memo of parties to include complete addresses.
Index of documents with page numbering is mandatory.
E-filing is mandatory — hard copies to be filed within two working days.
Court fee stamp of appropriate denomination to be affixed.
